verdict.rationale: Asana runs an App Directory (asana.com/apps) listing many first- and third-party integrations, including Slack, Jira, GitHub, GitLab, Figma, Notion, Salesforce-connected workflows and Stripe. It also lists connector hubs like Zapier, Pipedream, n8n and Skyvia, which extend reach to a much wider set of tools. Missing for 10: no explicit evidence the directory itself holds 'thousands' of apps, no documentation of the install/connect flow for a non-technical PM, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
